data.one_liner: Flutter widget to play voice messages with drag‑to‑seek and caching
data.what_it_does: VoiceMessageView plays an audio file from a URL or local source. It supports play, pause, seek by dragging the waveform, and caches the file for offline use.
use_when: You need a voice message player in a chat UI
You want built‑in caching and drag‑to‑seek
You prefer a ready‑made widget over configuring just_audio manually
avoid_when: You need advanced audio features like equalizer or streaming
You want full control over audio playback without a widget wrapper
data.setup_notes: Add voice_message_package to pubspec.yaml and run flutter pub get

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level audio playback control if you need more customization

data.minimal_example:
VoiceMessageView(
  controller: VoiceController(
    audioSrc: 'https://example.com/audio.mp3',
    onComplete: () {},
  ),
  maxDuration: const Duration(seconds: 10),
  isFile: false,
  innerPadding: 12,
  cornerRadius: 20,
)
